measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allow Providence to borrow up to $25 million through general-obligation bonds and notes for the Providence Housing Trust Fund to finance affordable multifamily housing projects in the city.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve up to $25 million in borrowing for those affordable housing projects through the trust fund.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed housing borrowing authority.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Set investment restrictions concerning foreign countries conducting ethnic cleansing, apartheid, illegal military occupation or genocide, using the listed United Nations, U.S. and International Court of Justice findings, and corporations that directly and knowingly enable those violations. The policy would cover city funds overseen by the investment commissioners, including retirement funds. To the best of its ability, the city would avoid new holdings of covered foreign-government debt and direct investments in those corporations; existing direct corporate investments would end subject to fiduciary duties. For pooled accounts and state-managed funds, the city would publicly ask managers to consider the restrictions. The policy would not apply where it would violate obligations to pensioners and beneficiaries. The treasurer would review holdings upon passage and annually, and submit a public implementation report to the city clerk by January 31 each year.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve those investment restrictions, fiduciary-duty exceptions, requests to pooled-fund managers, annual reviews and public reports.
